summary: Two extractor-wrapper docs overstate matching behavior or omit an observable bounds exception.

items.issue: “an array always matches” is too broad: `isEmpty` makes extraction non-failing, but sequence patterns can still fail when the array does not meet their arity requirements (for example, `Array.empty[Int]` does not match `Array(x)`).
items.suggestion: Say that the extractor result is never empty (or that extraction itself cannot fail), and leave pattern-arity matching to `lengthCompare` and related operations.

items.issue: The documentation states the valid index range but omits the material `ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException` thrown by the delegated array access when the index is outside that range.
items.suggestion: Add `@throws ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException if i < 0 or i >= the length of the wrapped array`.
